## 中文

- 新增 ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta2 插件卡片，支持用户主动下载官方 ELF、固定大小和 SHA-256 校验、本地缓存、取消下载及推送 PS5。
- 补齐游戏目录与 `.exfat` / `.ffpkg` 镜像的加载说明：文件上传到 `/data/homebrew/` 后，在 PS5 确认 ShadowMountPlus 启动、扫描、游戏注册及实际运行结果。已有镜像无需仅为加载插件重新上传。
- 重写中英文 README 与详细指南，说明电脑 Wi-Fi 下载资源、有线网卡直连 PS5 的网络配置，并提供中英文七步流程图。
- 新增组件校验失败、取消下载、缓存保留及界面组件完整性测试。53 项自动化测试通过；官方 ELF 下载、缓存复检及本地模拟 TCP 接收验证通过。

Windows x64 提供安装版与便携版；macOS Intel、Apple Silicon 分别提供 DMG 和 ZIP。所有包未代码签名，macOS 未公证。

ShadowMountPlus 的上游说明列出 Kstuff-lite v1.07+ 作为运行环境；其 1.7 系列声明支持至固件 13.60。本项目尚未验证具体固件、游戏或当前 Kstuff FPKG 测试版组合。ELF 发送完成不代表服务已启动、镜像已挂载或游戏可运行；当前不通过其管理 API 确认主机状态，也不自动修改 API 的本机监听设置。上游提示镜像挂载可能导致关机问题或数据损坏，请备份重要数据。

本项目仅供技术交流与合法授权测试。用户须自行提供有权使用的内容；构建包不附带网页资源、第三方 ELF 或游戏资源。初次下载需要电脑联网，本地传输不要求 PS5 连接互联网；网页和第三方插件自身的外网依赖取决于所选资源。完整使用边界与免责声明见 README。

## English

- Add a ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta2 component card with user-initiated official ELF downloads, pinned size and SHA-256 checks, local caching, download cancellation and delivery to PS5.
- Document game folder and `.exfat` / `.ffpkg` image loading: after upload to `/data/homebrew/`, confirm ShadowMountPlus startup, scanning, game registration and execution on PS5. Existing images do not need uploading again just to load the component.
- Rewrite the Chinese and English README and detailed guides around computer Wi-Fi downloads and a direct Ethernet connection to PS5, with bilingual seven-step diagrams.
- Add coverage for corrupt component downloads, cancellation, cache preservation and shipped component cards. All 53 automated tests pass; official ELF download, cache verification and a local simulated TCP receiver check also pass.

Windows x64 includes installer and portable packages; macOS Intel and Apple Silicon each include DMG and ZIP packages. All builds are unsigned; macOS builds are not notarized.

ShadowMountPlus upstream lists Kstuff-lite v1.07+ as its runtime environment and declares support through firmware 13.60 for its 1.7 series. This project has not verified specific firmware, games or the current Kstuff FPKG test-version combination. ELF delivery does not confirm service startup, mounting or game execution. The app does not confirm console status through its management API or automatically change its loopback listener settings. Upstream warns that image mounting may cause shutdown problems or data corruption; back up important data.

For technical exchange and authorized testing. Users must supply content they are authorized to use. Builds do not bundle web resources, third-party ELFs or game content. Initial downloads need internet access on the computer; local transfers do not require PS5 internet access. Any external dependency of a page or component depends on the selected resource. See the README for usage boundaries and the full disclaimer.
